$comment: Lifestyle practices (rule set lifestyle-practices, clinical-content/registry.json): labels of the stored values, thresholds, negation-aware match terms and regex patterns (ICU and JavaScript), prompt and plan-line wording and sources. The single source for web (lib/triage-engine/src/lifestyle-practices.ts) and iOS (LifestylePractices.swift, bundled folder "rules"); which finding raises which prompt or suggestion stays in code. Validated by lint:shared-content. From the practice owner's evidence briefing (Sept 2026); unreviewed (docs/clinical-validation/changes/lifestyle-practices.md). No text may tell anyone to take, hold, stop or adjust a named medicine (H-10).

promptText.fastingInsulin: Fasting with insulin/sulfonylurea: risk of hypoglycaemia and dehydration — pre-fast risk stratification and medication review recommended (IDF-DAR 2021).
promptText.fastingDiabetes: Fasting with diabetes: risk of hypoglycaemia and dehydration — pre-fast risk stratification recommended (IDF-DAR 2021).
promptText.fastingPeriop: Religious fast overlaps the pre-operative fast — check hydration and glucose plan.
promptText.nightShiftSleep: Night-shift work / short sleep is associated with metabolic, cardiovascular and mood disorders.

promptSources.idfDar: IDF-DAR Diabetes and Ramadan: Practical Guidelines 2021 (cited in the practice evidence briefing, Sept 2026, §4)
promptSources.briefingFasting: Practice evidence briefing (Dr D. D. Kabiye, Sept 2026), §4 — Ramadan and Orthodox fasting
promptSources.briefingSleep: Practice evidence briefing (Dr D. D. Kabiye, Sept 2026), §4 and §8 — sleep, circadian timing and protected rest

sources.taiChi: Huang ZG et al. Tai Chi for fall prevention and balance improvement in older adults: systematic review and meta-analysis of RCTs. Front Public Health 2023 (24 RCTs; falls RR 0.76).
sources.yoga: Saper RB et al. Yoga, physical therapy, or education for chronic low back pain: a randomized noninferiority trial. Ann Intern Med 2017;167:85-94.
sources.mbct: Kuyken W et al. Efficacy of MBCT in prevention of depressive relapse: an individual patient data meta-analysis. JAMA Psychiatry 2016;73:565-74 (relapse HR 0.69).
sources.slowBreathing: Practice evidence briefing (Dr D. D. Kabiye, Sept 2026), §4 and §8 — slow breathing (no primary reference listed).
sources.acupuncture: Vickers AJ et al. Acupuncture for chronic pain: individual patient data meta-analysis. Arch Intern Med 2012; update J Pain 2018.
sources.timeRestricted: Liu D et al. Calorie restriction with or without time-restricted eating in weight loss. N Engl J Med 2022;386:1495-1504.
sources.cuppingDetox: Practice evidence briefing (Dr D. D. Kabiye, Sept 2026), §6 and §8 — cupping, detox teas, colon cleanses (no benefit).
sources.ivDrips: Practice evidence briefing (Dr D. D. Kabiye, Sept 2026), §6 — "biohacking" add-ons: IV vitamin drips (mixed).

planLines.taiChi: Non-drug: tai chi programme for balance and falls prevention (evidence: works — 24 RCTs, falls RR 0.76; Huang ZG et al. 2023).
planLines.yoga: Non-drug: structured yoga programme for chronic non-specific low back pain (evidence: works — non-inferior to physical therapy; Saper RB et al., Ann Intern Med 2017).
planLines.mbct: Referral option: mindfulness-based cognitive therapy (MBCT) for relapse prevention in recurrent depression (evidence: works — HR 0.69; Kuyken W et al., JAMA Psychiatry 2016).
planLines.slowBreathing: Non-drug: slow breathing (about 6 breaths a minute) for short-term anxiety relief, e.g. before the procedure — not a treatment for high blood pressure (evidence: modest).
planLines.acupuncture: Referral option: acupuncture for chronic pain (evidence: modest — small margin over sham; Vickers AJ et al., Arch Intern Med 2012).
planLines.timeRestricted: Non-drug: time-restricted eating as an adherence strategy for weight management — weight loss similar to calorie restriction (evidence: modest; Liu D et al., NEJM 2022).
planLines.timeRestrictedDiabetesNote: Diabetes on insulin/sulfonylurea: hypoglycaemia risk during fasting windows — pre-fast risk stratification and medication review recommended before starting (IDF-DAR 2021).
planLines.cupping: Discussed cupping: no reliable evidence of benefit beyond placebo.
planLines.detox: Discussed detox teas / colon cleanses: no reliable evidence of benefit; risks of dehydration, electrolyte disturbance and laxative dependence.
planLines.ivDrips: Discussed IV vitamin drips: little outcome evidence outside a specific medical indication; risks of infection and fluid overload.

reasons.backPain: Low back pain recorded (evidence is for chronic non-specific low back pain)
reasons.depression: Depression recorded (evidence is for relapse prevention in recurrent depression)
reasons.chronicPain: Back or neck pain, osteoarthritis or chronic headache recorded (evidence is for chronic pain)
